shape.text: Linear's changelog of 2021-08-19 says API keys and OAuth access tokens were changed to carry the prefixes lin_api_ and lin_oauth_ so that GitHub secret scanning could detect them. A personal API key begins lin_api_.
After the prefix come 40 letters and digits, with no underscore or hyphen in the body. The length and alphabet come from two scanner rules that agree; Linear states only the prefix.

collisions.text: The lin_oauth_ prefix marks a separate credential, an OAuth access token, and its body is not the 40-character API key body.
One scanner has a separate, context-gated rule for a 32-character hexadecimal Linear client secret, which is another Linear value.
